paragraphs: In [Yoma 78b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.78b.1), Rabbah bar bar Chana said: “I saw Rabbi Elazar of Nineveh go out in a sandal of bast.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Bavli spells out Rabbi Elazar of Nineveh and identifies Rabbah bar bar Chana as the eyewitness.
Both the Bavli and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=539&lang=en) specify that the sandal was worn on a communal fast day. Hyman quotes only the opening of the report.
